approach.en: The payment can travel. Your personal life does not have to travel with it.

approach.es: El pago puede viajar. Tu vida personal no tiene que ir con él.

en.sentence: Zcash brings a simple expectation to digital money: a payment can reach another person without putting its private details on public display.
en.30s: Zcash brings a simple expectation to digital money: a payment can reach another person without putting its private details on public display. Splitting lunch or paying someone back should not require a public account of your life. With a fully shielded Zcash transfer, the sender, recipient and amount stay off the public record while the network verifies the payment.
en.60s:
Zcash brings a simple expectation to digital money: a payment can reach another person without putting its private details on public display. Splitting lunch or paying someone back should not require a public account of your life. With a fully shielded Zcash transfer, the sender, recipient and amount stay off the public record while the network verifies the payment.

That makes privacy part of an ordinary exchange, rather than something reserved for exceptional situations. Start with a wallet that supports shielded transfers and check the payment details before sending.

en.sentence: If Bitcoin got you interested in open money, Zcash adds another question: how much should a payment reveal to everyone else?
en.30s: If Bitcoin got you interested in open money, Zcash adds another question: how much should a payment reveal to everyone else? Zcash has its own network and currency, ZEC. Its shielded transfers keep sensitive payment details off the public ledger while allowing the network to verify the transaction. It is a way to explore digital money where participation in a public network does not require public payment details.

The useful comparison is about design choices: what the system validates and what the public can learn. You can value an open network and still want a private financial life.

en.sentence: Zcash lets a business receive shielded payments without publishing each customer relationship and payment amount to the public blockchain.
en.30s: Zcash lets a business receive shielded payments without publishing each customer relationship and payment amount to the public blockchain. en.sentence: A payment network needs to check that money moves according to its rules; Zcash shows that this need not mean publishing every private detail.
en.30s: A payment network needs to check that money moves according to its rules; Zcash shows that this need not mean publishing every private detail. Think of the difference between proving that a requirement is satisfied and showing everyone the information behind it. Zcash uses zero-knowledge proofs as part of verifying shielded transfers. The network gets the evidence it needs, while the public does not get the sender, recipient and amount of a fully shielded payment.

A payment network needs to check that money moves according to its rules; Zcash shows that this need not mean publishing every private detail. Think of the difference between proving that a requirement is satisfied and showing everyone the information behind it. Zcash uses zero-knowledge proofs as part of verifying shielded transfers. The network gets the evidence it needs, while the public does not get the sender, recipient and amount of a fully shielded payment.

That distinction is the heart of the explanation. You can introduce the mathematical details later; first, make clear that verification and public disclosure are different jobs.

en.sentence: An address without a name can still leave a public trail of activity; Zcash shielding protects the payment details themselves.
en.30s: An address without a name can still leave a public trail of activity; Zcash shielding protects the payment details themselves. On a transparent ledger, people can examine transfers even when they do not immediately know who owns an address. Other information may later give those records more context. A fully shielded Zcash transfer takes a different approach by keeping its sender, recipient and amount out of public view from the start.

en.sentence: Small payments can say a lot when combined; Zcash helps keep the details of shielded transfers out of that public collection.
